observations: Photo 0: bare engine assembly on a stand, diesel-style intake manifold, EGR valve/wiring, viscous fan clutch with plastic fan blade, turbo inlet pipe visible, surrounded by other scrap parts in what looks like a dismantler's yard.
Photo 1: same engine, front view, showing a light-blue/grey rocker cover with a Toyota oval logo embossed on it, timing/accessory belt, multiple pulleys, fan clutch assembly.
No engine code, ID plate, or serial number is legible in either photo.
No oil pan, sump, or underside of block shown; no view of injectors, turbo housing close-up, or wiring harness connectors.
Engine is static, dusty/oily, sitting among other used parts; no indication it has been started or tested.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI UCHENNA' overlays both images, consistent with a Jiji.ng listing screenshot, not a studio/certified photo.

identity.kind: Toyota diesel engine (D-4D type, long block with accessories)

claims.claim: This is a Toyota 1KD-FTV (3.0L) or 2KD-FTV (2.5L) D-4D turbo-diesel engine
claims.evidence: Toyota logo visible on rocker cover in photo 1, but no engine code or displacement marking is legible in either photo to distinguish 1KD from 2KD.

risks.risk: Exact engine variant (1KD-FTV 3.0L vs 2KD-FTV 2.5L) is unconfirmed, and these carry different market values in Lagos.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped engine block code/serial number plate, usually on the block near the bellhousing or on a riveted ID tag.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-value variant (2KD-FTV) until the plate is shown

risks.risk: Running condition is completely unverified; engine could have internal faults (compression, injector, turbo, timing chain) not visible from static photos.
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine being started and running, or at minimum a compression test readout.

risks.risk: Completeness of accessories (turbo, injectors, ECU, wiring harness, starter, alternator) cannot be confirmed beyond what is visible.
risks.proof: Additional photos from both sides and the rear (flywheel/bellhousing end) showing all ancillaries attached.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare long block only, missing ancillaries not clearly visible

risks.risk: Mileage/history and reason for removal (accident, flood, engine swap) cannot be assessed.
risks.proof: Photo of the donor vehicle's VIN plate or import paperwork, if available.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine code/serial number stamped on the block or on an ID tag, to confirm 1KD-FTV vs 2KD-FTV.
Video of the engine running or at least turning over with video/audio proof.
Photos from the rear (bellhousing/flywheel side) and underside (oil pan) to confirm completeness and absence of damage.
Any paperwork or VIN reference tying the engine to its donor vehicle.
response.reason: The seller offers two distinct engine models (1KD-FTV vs 2KD-FTV) with different market values, but no engine code or ID plate is legible in either photo to settle which one this is, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored without that shot.
